jobs.occupation: Account Receivable & Credit Officer - Brussels - Food Sector
jobs.description:

Description

Headit is looking for an English- and French-speaking Sales Support Administrator for the Middle East & Africa regions.

Would you like to join a European organization that plays a key role in shaping the future of the lobbying sector? Our client is looking for an Assistant to support the activities of the Lobbying  sector.
 

In this role, you will provide administrative, organisational and communication support to the Sector Group Manager. You will also interact regularly with internal teams, industry members and external stakeholders.
 

This varied position offers the opportunity to contribute to event coordination, sector activities and communication management within a dynamic European environment.
 

Key Responsibilities
 
 
 
• Provide administrative and organisational support to the Sector Group Manager 
 
• Support sector management and advocacy activities 
 
• Assist with strategic engagement on key policy topics and interactions with policymakers 
 
• Organise meetings, conference calls and appointments 
 
• Coordinate and arrange business travel 
 
• Support the planning and organisation of workshops and events 
 
• Manage task forces or sub-groups within the sector 
 
• Prepare draft activity reports summarising communication analytics, events and publications 
 
• Manage the sector group’s website and communication channels 
 
• Publish news items and newsletters 
 
• Create visuals using Canva and schedule posts on LinkedIn and Twitter via Hootsuite 
 
• Maintain and update the membership database (Salesforce) 
 
• Manage and organise the library of relevant information for members 

 
 
• Bachelor’s degree in Office Management or a similar field 
 
• 3–5 years of experience in an assistant role, preferably supporting senior management 
 
• Excellent written and spoken English (additional languages are an asset) 
 
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) 
 
• Good knowledge of digital tools, website management and social media platforms 
 
• Strong organisational and time management skills with the ability to prioritise tasks 
 
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 
 
• Proactive, solution-oriented and well organised 
 
• Able to work independently while being a strong team player 
 
• Comfortable working in a dynamic and fast-paced environment 
 
• Curious, flexible and eager to learn

I-Coats
 

I-Coats NV is an internationally active SME, founded in 2006 and based in Berchem (Antwerp), Belgium. With a team of approximately 10 employees, the company develops and commercializes innovative overlay finishes and coatings for ropes, nets and steel cables. Through production partners, its products are supplied worldwide to customers across Europe, the United States, Canada, China and Korea. With an annual turnover of €6 million and 90% export activity, 
I-Coats is a dynamic and internationally oriented company with strong growth ambitions.
 

To strengthen the team, we are looking for an experienced and technically strong: 
Project Manager
 

Your role 
 

In this role, you will take a leading position in the development of coatings for customer-specific applications, operating at the intersection of R&D and practical implementation. You will act both as a technical expert and as a project lead, playing a key role in translating customer needs into high-performance and innovative coating solutions.
 

As 
Project Manager, you will be end-to-end responsible for the development and implementation of tailor-made coatings for industrial applications.
 

Your responsibilities
 
 

• Develop advanced coatings in co-creation with customers, tailored to their specific applications and requirements. 

• Analyze technical challenges and translate them into concrete development and testing trajectories. 

• Work closely with the laboratory team in setting up, executing and interpreting tests. You will evaluate coating performance and make adjustments based on test results and customer feedback. 

• Identify new applications and innovation opportunities with both existing and prospective customers. 

• Ensure a smooth transition from laboratory results to effective production and closely monitor the implementation process. 

• Safeguard technical know-how and actively contribute to the further development of expertise within 
I-Coats’ product niche. 

• Report directly to the Technical Director.  

Your profile
 
 

• You hold a higher technical degree in a relevant field (preferably a Master’s degree in Chemistry, Materials Science or similar). 

• You have several years of experience in an R&D, application engineering or project-driven environment within a multidisciplinary context. 

• You have a strong affinity with coatings and chemical formulations. 

• You combine technical knowledge with a pragmatic mindset and a strong focus on applicability. 

• You work in a structured manner and are capable of independently managing complex projects. 

• You communicate clearly and professionally with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

• You speak Dutch very well. 

• You have a good command of English and solid knowledge of MS Office applications such as Excel and Word.

As Foreman of the Spacer Production ZZ department, you are responsible for coordinating and supervising the production process. You provide operational leadership to a team of approximately 5 operators and ensure that production runs smoothly and according to quality standards and production targets.

You monitor the production schedule and progress and ensure the efficient use of employees, machines and materials. You perform quality checks, monitor process parameters and take corrective action when necessary.

You are also responsible for maintaining a safe working environment and ensuring compliance with safety and environmental regulations. You collect and analyse production data such as output, quality and productivity and report this information clearly to the Production Manager.

From a technical perspective, you carry out minor repairs, identify when components need preventive replacement and independently perform complex machine changeovers

 
• 
Demonstrable experience in a production environment.

 
• 
Good technical knowledge.

 
• 
Practical and hands-on approach.

 
• 
Interest in machinery and willingness to work alongside the production team.

 
• 
Natural leadership skills and the ability to lead by example.

 
• 
Good communication skills in Dutch and English.

 
• 
Ability to train and guide operators according to their knowledge and experience.

 
• 
Strong problem-solving skills.

 
• 
Ability to make decisions under pressure.

 
• 
Stress-resistant and able to remain calm in challenging situations.

 
• 
Good planning, organisational and prioritisation skills.

WE’RE HIRING!
 

We recruit a motivated sales advisor who sees a challenge in the following responsibilities and focal points:
 
 

• You provide customers with an excellent and premium shopping experience. You provide special and inspiring service beyond customer expectations and maintain a loyal and personal approach. 

• You apply mandatory sales standards and use up-to-date technical product knowledge to increase sales. 

• You follow guidelines related to store opening and closing, dress code, hygiene, health and safety, money matters, etc. 

• You ensure a pleasant and clean store floor with beautifully presented and correctly priced products.

We expect a sales advisor to:

• Be a flexible, enthusiastic, and smooth team player.  

• Be informed on new market trends, client wishes and the competition.

WE’RE HIRING!
 

The store manager is responsible for the daily direction of the store, in order to become a profitable store, within the predetermined budgets.
 

The job of the store manager includes, but is not limited to, these following important tasks:
 

 
 

Analysis of the shop performance

Client Service

Personnel Management

Stock

• You check that the products are priced correctly and you minimize the losses in order to reach the company numbers.  

Operations
 
 

• You are responsible for an accurate and a trustworthy compliance of the daily procedures (money and banking, shop opening and closing, health and safety, etc.). 

• You ensure that the repairs are being followed-up professionally and accurately.  

Merchandising, Marketing & Promotions
 
 

• You take care of the shop and window presentation and lay-out in accordance with the defined standards. 

• You take care of a full preparation and implementation of promotions and the correct use of promotion materials. 

We expect a store manager to:

• Be flexible and be able to work weekends. 

• Communicate in a clear, concise and understandable way and to listen to others.

• Act as an ambassador of the company, who lives by the values and shows passion for the brand.

jobs.occupation: Senior R&D Specialist - Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy
jobs.description:
About you and this role
 

At Dow, our Analytical Science organization plays a critical role in accelerating innovation, supporting manufacturing excellence, and solving complex technical challenges across our global businesses.
 

The Analytical Science team in Seneffe is a key part of this global network, providing world-class analytical expertise to support research, product development, process optimization, and customer-focused innovation. Leveraging advanced analytical technologies and deep scientific knowledge, the team partners closely with R&D, manufacturing, and commercial organizations to deliver impactful solutions across a broad range of material science applications.
 

We now have an exciting opportunity for a 
Senior R&D Specialist – Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy to join our Analytical Science division in 
Seneffe, Belgium.
 

In this role, you will apply advanced analytical techniques to solve complex challenges in industrial chemistry and materials science. Working closely with global R&D, manufacturing, and business teams, you will provide critical insights that support product development, process optimization, manufacturing excellence, and customer-focused innovation.
 

As a subject matter expert in Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy, you will lead analytical investigations, develop new measurement methodologies in a world class NMR lab with global resources, and enhance existing analytical capabilities. This role offers the opportunity to collaborate across a diverse global network while supporting multiple high-impact projects simultaneously.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Lead analytical investigations to resolve complex technical, product, and manufacturing challenges. 

• Develop, optimize, and implement advanced NMR methodologies to expand analytical capabilities. 

• Manage and maintain state of the art NMR instrumentation including cryoprobe technology. 

• Interpret complex analytical data and provide technical leadership on projects involving materials characterization, process optimization, and product performance. 

• Drive innovation through the application of advanced analytical techniques and scientific problem solving. 

• Share technical expertise, mentor colleagues, and contribute to capability building within the Analytical Sciences community. 

• Ensure delivery of high-quality analytical results while managing multiple priorities and project timelines.  

Qualifications
 
 

• Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Polymer Science, Materials Science, Biochemistry, Physics, Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline. 

• Demonstrated expertise in Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy including method development and advanced applications, for example in multidimensional solution-state NMR, pulse programming, solid-state NMR, and/or DNP-NMR. 

• Strong knowledge in at least two of the following areas: analytical chemistry, polymer science, organic chemistry, materials science, coatings or formulation science, chemical processing, polymer characterization, or statistics/data analysis. 

• Proven track record of applying analytical science to solve complex technical challenges. 

• Experience supporting research, product development, manufacturing, or process optimization programs. 

• Fluency in English, both written and verbal. 

• Additional language skills, preferable French, Dutch, Italian, Spanish or German are an advantage.  

Additional Notes
 
 

• This position does not offer relocation assistance 

• Please submit your application in English to be eligible for consideration in the selection process.  

 

Benefits – What Dow offers you
 

We invest in you.
 

Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
 

Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
 
 

• Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives. 

• Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it. 

• Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals. 
 

• Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).   

• Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only). 
 

• Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.   

• Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations. 

• Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building. 

• Workplace culture empowering role-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs. 

• Competitive yearly vacation allowance. 

• Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents). 

• Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured. 

• Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation. 

• Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey. 

• On-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location). 

• Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more. 

• Additionally, some of our locations might offer: 
 

• Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location) 

• Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location) 

• Carbon-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)    

Join our team, we can make a difference together.

For a meat company in Zele, we are looking for a production worker who will be working in various departments.
 

Your tasks:
- placing meat on the production line;
- cutting meat (cutting skills are not required);
- packing;
- loading and unloading trucks.

- You're looking for a physical, varied job in a production environment. 
- You communicate smoothly, with knowledge of Dutch, English, French, and/or Romanian. 
- You like working independently, but you're also a team player. 
- You take responsibility and are reliable. 
- You can work under pressure and set the right priorities. 
- You're flexible with working hours: start between 3:30 AM and 6:30 AM, and you work until everything is done. 
- You're fine working in a cold environment and standing up.

Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• Hands-on work with real responsibility

• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market

• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow

Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• Experience in a production environment is a plus, but if you’re motivated and hands-on, we’ll get you up to speed.

• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.

One of your main tasks will be to investigate complaints, deviations, out-of-specifications (OOS) and non-conformities, draft a report on these and propose corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

You will take on a part of the batch release activities of the medicines and other medical products produced on site. Additionally, you will monitor compliance to the internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and GMP (flows and zoning included) in production and the laboratory.

More specific: 

• Investigation and drafting of report for deviations; OOS; complaints and non-conformitiesMonitor compliance on internal standard operating procedures (SOP’s) and GMP in production and laboratory area
• Final batch release - including review of batch records (1-2h per day)
• GMP/GDP/Pharmacovigilance training of QC and production operators; warehouse workers and drivers.
• Writing of the yearly PQR (Product Quality Review)
• Review of QC and GMP procedures
• Involvement in GMP validation and qualification activities (equipment and processes in production and laboratory area) and other GMP projects
• Management of CAPA’s related to GMP activities
• Management of change controls related to GMP activities
• Support during (preparation of) audits on site
• Perform internal audits at other sites and suppliers

• You have a master degree in Industrial pharmacy
• You have at least 1 or 3 year experience in a GMP environment.
• You are a teamplayer, dynamic and have very good communication skills.
• Your mothertongue is Dutch and are fluent in English and French

About the role

As Group Marketing Director, you lead Beaulieu's central marketing team. Guided by strategic insights, you act as the group's marketing center of excellence, shaping marketing strategy and supporting divisions in building and executing their growth plans.In parallel, you oversee the shared marketing services within Beaulieu, including events, graphic design, and digital marketing, ensuring every division benefits from consistent, high-quality execution.You lead a team of marketing professionals, combining strategic vision with hands-on leadership to translate ideas into impact and ensure that both strategy and execution meet the highest standards.

 

Key responsibilities
 
• You collaborate closely with divisional management and marketeers to develop and execute marketing strategies that drive growth. Acting as a strategic partner, you help identify where marketing can create the greatest impact, align priorities, and turn direction into measurable action. 
• You act as a trusted marketing partner to senior management and division leaders, translating their commercial priorities into marketing action, and representing marketing's voice in group-level decision-making. 
• You lead, coach, and develop the central marketing team, bringing together expertise in CRM, events, graphic design, and digital marketing. You set clear priorities and ensures the team operates as both a center of excellence and a trusted shared services partner to the divisions. 
• Together with divisional marketing teams, you lead the execution of creative, high-impact campaigns across the group, translating strategic priorities into initiatives that deliver results. 
• In close collaboration with divisional marketing and sales teams, you ensure marketing acts as a true commercial growth partner. You provide the insights, tools, and content that help sales engage customers more effectively, while aligning messaging, positioning, and value propositions. 
• You oversee relationships with external partners, including agencies, freelancers, and technology providers, ensuring high-quality delivery and maximizing the value of external expertise across the group. 
• You own the group marketing budget, allocating resources across shared services and divisional needs, and ensuring spend translates into measurable ROI. 
• You lead the group's CRM center of excellence, developing the capabilities, standards, and support needed to maximize the value of Salesforce CRM across the organization. By driving adoption, enabling best practices, and fostering cross-functional collaboration, you ensure CRM is leveraged consistently and effectively across departments. 
• You work closely with the Corporate Communications Director to ensure strong alignment between marketing and communication efforts across the organization. By coordinating branding initiatives, organizational events, and strategic communications, you drive consistency, leverage synergies, and avoid duplication of efforts across the group.  
 

What you bring
 
• At least 10 years of experience in a marketing leadership role. Experience within an international, multi-business organization with a central/decentralized operating model is a plus. 
• Strategic marketing: you know how to segment markets, define positioning, and translate market insights into a marketing strategy and plan aligned with business needs. Proven experience in developing and executing integrated marketing strategies with measurable business impact. 
• Digital marketing: SEO/GEO, paid advertising, email marketing and automation, and digital experience and platforms. Solid understanding of digital marketing, campaign management, and performance analytics. 
• Lead generation: You know how to design and drive campaigns that generate qualified leads and support the sales funnel. 
• You are a trusted partner who operates seamlessly across organizational boundaries. Bridging group and divisional interests, strategic priorities and business execution, and marketing and executive leadership, you create alignment, build commitment, and help the organization move forward with a shared sense of purpose. 
• Excellent communication and presentation skills (in English). 
• Proactive, structured, and results-oriented with a hands-on mentality.

can you recognise yourself in this?
